scope: One public manual Tabs task; React18.3.1/react-dom18.3.1/Vite6.4.1, pinned Radix1.1.13 available to all; library arm must integrate Radix. No deterministic Tabs path is admitted in this study.

models.unavailableReason: Provider does not expose these fields through the participant tool/session; inherited configuration is held constant, exact hidden backend identity is not asserted.

tools.participant: same exec/file editing/public-search capabilities; local Node24.22.3/npm11.19.1; clean npm ci and production build
tools.isolation: Separate fresh forks and packet directories; instruction enforced only, not secure filesystem isolation. No formal blind/held-out claim.

budget.correctnessTarget: 22/22 task checks with no runtime or cleanup errors; stop at first complete observation or explicit refusal/abandonment/budget exhaustion. Protocol limits are instructed, actual deviations retained.
budget.noImplementationAssistance: Feedback contains actual failed observation and relevant task requirement, not replacement code or hidden oracle.

scoring.firstFailure: Evaluator is sequential; later checks are not-run, never counted as passes. Record full vector and independent adjudication.
scoring.initialEntryDecision: Only before the first keyboard entry, a single focusable tablist may delegate to selected tab; real Tab must reach selected tab and all later states require one enabled tab stop.
legalStructures: retained hidden panels with one reciprocal owner each
scoring.disputes: Keep raw automated result. Any code-supported equivalent behavior or count prose/numeric ambiguity is an oracle dispute for separate independent adjudication, not an automatic product defect. Do not alter the frozen evaluator to fit participants.
limits: Bounded 12-Tab reachability is not universal keyboard accessibility
Live DOM/role observation is not proof of announcement by AT
No business composition or complete library conclusion

maintenance.afterInitialOutcome: Add a standard More information link inside each rendered active panel (href #reference-information), preserve every task behavior, and change the polite count wording to Completed actions: N. Keep dependency pins.
maintenance.oracle: same frozen 22 checks plus source-bound confirmation of the requested link and wording
maintenance.scope: Small in-place content change, not long-term or cross-target maintenance economics

stressScenario.assumption: Implementation iterations and test execution have zero marginal token/test expense for interpretation; this is an adverse accounting assumption, not a measurement or prediction.
stressScenario.availableComparison: unassisted versus knowledge-assisted, with library integration reported separately; same collected initial runs and repair trajectories serve #734 and #751 and are not independent replications.
retainedCosts: unavailable actual token/compute/billing recorded as null with reason
stressScenario.limits: Fixed finite repair cap; no future AI forecast, no broad deterministic projection advantage, no attribution of any measured equality to statistical equivalence.
